title: The Pulse: Anthropic builds its own source control system
author: Ivan Klaric
description: Git had too many performance problems at 30,000 PRs per day, so Anthropic built its own. I talked with the team, including asking why they didn’t open source its new system, ‘Scion.’
summary: Hi, this is Gergely with a bonus, free issue of the Pragmatic Engineer Newsletter. In every issue, I cover Big Tech and startups through the lens of senior engineers and engineering leaders.
takeaways: Backups : on top of replication, Anthropic keeps full backups of the database and soft deletes on the blob storage where file contents live.
Interesting information from Anthropic about why the company moved off Git and built its own custom source control system.
In May 2026, Anthropic averaged around 2,500 code changes merged per day; as of September, we merged over 30,000 per day.
